title_sq: Tek 21-Dhjetori, Shiten Dy Apartamente 1+1 Perfekte Per Investim!!
description_sq: Tek 21-Dhjetori, Shiten Dy Apartamente 1+1 Perfekte Per Investim!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje pallati ekzistues pa ashensor, buze rruges se Kavajes dhe organizohet ne dy apartamente 1+1 totalisht te investuar dhe te mobiluara me arkitekt. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nga zonat me te mira te Tiranes duke e bere nje mundesi shume te mire per investim, si per qira mujore edhe per qira ditore. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: On December 21, two 1+1 apartments for sale, perfect for investment!!
description_en: On December 21, two 1+1 apartments for sale, perfect for investment!! The property is located on the 5th floor of an existing building without an elevator, on the edge of Kavaje street, and is organized into two 1+1 apartments, fully invested and furnished by an architect. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the best areas of Tirana, making it a very good opportunity for investment, both for monthly rent and daily rent. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
